data.summary_suggestion: Retrieve user subscription status and reward eligibility
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves the authenticated user's Pro subscription status and current reward benefit eligibility. Returns subscription tier, active status, and `hasReward` boolean indicating if the user can purchase reward products this month. The `hasReward` flag transitions from true to false after purchasing a reward product and resets to true on the first day of the following month for active Pro subscribers. Recommended to call on app launch and cache locally in UserDefaults (iOS) or SharedPreferences (Android) to control reward product cart availability.

data.summary_suggestion: Calculate checkout total with product and reward validation
data.description_suggestion: Calculates the total checkout price including fees, taxes, and discounts while performing comprehensive product and user eligibility validations. Validates: product existence and active status, user permissions for reward products (requires `hasReward: true` from `/subscription/status`), available stock, payment method compatibility, quantity limits, and reward product restrictions (max 1 reward product per order, Free users cannot purchase reward products). Returns itemized pricing breakdown, total amount, and applicable fees. Does not process payment or create orders - use `/process-payment` after price validation. Returns 422 for business rule violations (invalid product, insufficient stock, reward eligibility mismatch) and 400 for malformed requests.

data.current_description: Procesa el pago con el gateway seleccionado (Conekta, Stripe, Oxxo).
data.summary_suggestion: Process payment through selected gateway and create order
data.description_suggestion: Processes payment through the specified gateway (stripe for international cards, conekta for Mexico cards, oxxo for cash payments, orkestapay for alternative processing) and creates the order upon successful authorization. Validates: payment method ownership, product validity including reward eligibility, and gateway availability. Performs final reward product validation (user must have `hasReward: true`, max 1 reward product per order). Returns payment confirmation with transaction ID, order reference, and payment status. Side effects: creates order record, updates user reward status (sets `hasReward: false` if reward product purchased), and generates fulfillment records. Returns 200 on success, 422 for business rule violations (invalid gateway, reward eligibility mismatch, payment declined), 403 for permission errors.

data.current_description: Permite a un usuario redimir un cupón en un local específico.
data.summary_suggestion: Redeem coupon at location and generate redemption code
data.description_suggestion: Redeems a coupon for the authenticated user at a specified location, executing the complete redemption workflow. Validates user eligibility against coupon requirements and usage limits (non-Prime users have redemption limits). Generates unique redemption code (folio) and barcode/QR code for in-store validation. Creates redemption record in database, updates inventory, and updates user profile with interaction data (interests, socioeconomic level). Returns redemption confirmation including folio code, barcode/QR image, and redemption details. Side effects: decrements coupon inventory, creates usage record, updates user profile attributes. Requires coupon ID as path parameter and location information in request body. Returns 200 on success, 422 for business rule violations (user ineligible, usage limits exceeded, coupon expired), 404 if coupon not found.
